name: Motorcycle Simulator British Columbia
summary:
Ride Vancouver from the seat - alone, or with up to three friends.

27 KM OF REAL VANCOUVER
Downtown on West Georgia, the Georgia Viaduct past BC Place, East Hastings, the Ironworkers Bridge high over the Second Narrows, the Upper Levels Highway above the harbour, the Lions Gate Bridge and the forest of Stanley Park.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
